extDescription.message: Collects your beatmania IIDX play data from e-amusement and reflects it to iidx-rank.

error_interrupted.message: Collection was interrupted. The browser or extension may have restarted

error_tab_open_failed.message: Could not open a tab for collection

error_load_timeout.message: The page took too long to load

error_extract_failed.message: Could not read data from the page

error_unexpected_page.message: The page has an unexpected structure

error_login_unreadable.message: Could not read the login state

error_not_logged_in.message: You are not logged in to e-amusement

error_session_expired.message: Your e-amusement login expired. Please log in again

warning_page_no_response.message: Level $LEVEL$, offset $OFFSET$: the page did not respond

warning_page_extract_failed.message: Level $LEVEL$, offset $OFFSET$: could not read data from the page

warning_page_url_mismatch.message: Level $LEVEL$, offset $OFFSET$: an unexpected page was opened

warning_page_unexpected_page.message: Level $LEVEL$, offset $OFFSET$: the page has an unexpected structure

warning_page_rows_skipped.message: Level $LEVEL$, offset $OFFSET$: skipped $COUNT$ rows that could not be read

warning_level_first_page_empty.message: Level $LEVEL$: the first page has no songs

warning_level_page_limit.message: Level $LEVEL$: reached the page limit ($LIMIT$); later pages were not collected

warning_aborted_tab_closed.message: The collection tab was closed; remaining levels were not collected: $LEVELS$

warning_aborted_load_timeout.message: The page took too long to load; remaining levels were not collected: $LEVELS$

warning_aborted_session_expired.message: The e-amusement login expired; remaining levels were not collected: $LEVELS$

warning_aborted_repeated_failures.message: Repeated failures stopped collection; remaining levels were not collected: $LEVELS$

warning_charts_dropped.message: Excluded $COUNT$ charts with an invalid format

rank_reason_not_logged_in.message: Not reflected because you are not logged in to iidx-rank

rank_reason_dp_unsupported.message: DP data is not reflected to iidx-rank

rank_reason_no_data.message: There is no collected data to reflect

rank_reason_origin_rejected.message: The iidx-rank server did not allow requests from this extension. Check that the extension ID is registered on the server

rank_reason_rate_limited.message: Too many sync attempts in a short time. Please try again shortly

rank_reason_server_error.message: The iidx-rank server returned an error

rank_reason_invalid_payload.message: The data to reflect is invalid or too large

popup_error_background_unreachable.message: The background worker is not responding. Reopen the popup or reload the extension at chrome://extensions

popup_error_invalid_response.message: The background worker returned an invalid response. Reload the extension

popup_eamusement_hint_unchecked.message: The login state has not been checked yet. Use the button below to check it.

popup_eamusement_hint_logged_out.message: You need to log in to e-amusement in this browser to collect data. Log in, then check again.

popup_eamusement_hint_failed.message: Could not check the login state. Please try again shortly.

popup_rank_hint_unchecked.message: The iidx-rank login state has not been checked yet.

popup_rank_hint_logged_out.message: Open the iidx-rank login page and log in, then reopen this popup or press Check again. Collected data is reflected to the account you log in with.

popup_rank_hint_logged_in.message: Collected data is reflected to this account automatically when collection finishes.

popup_rank_hint_network.message: Could not connect to iidx-rank. Check your network and try again.

popup_rank_hint_server_error.message: The iidx-rank server returned an error. Please try again shortly.

popup_settings_note_scope.message: Only SP level 12 is reflected to iidx-rank. DP and other levels can be collected and exported, but are not reflected.

popup_settings_warning_dp.message: With DP selected, data is collected but not reflected to iidx-rank.

popup_reason_syncing.message: Not available while reflecting to iidx-rank.

popup_reason_login_unchecked.message: Check the e-amusement login state first.

popup_reason_login_failed.message: Cannot collect because the login state could not be checked. Check again.

popup_reason_login_required.message: You must log in to e-amusement to collect.

popup_reason_no_dataset.message: There is no saved data to reflect. Collect first.

popup_reason_rank_login_required.message: You must log in to iidx-rank to reflect data.

popup_dataset_empty.message: There is no saved data. Run a collection.

popup_clear_confirm_message.message: This deletes the saved collection data. It cannot be undone.

popup_sync_unmatched_hint.message: Level 12 charts not found in the iidx-rank song list. The song titles may be written differently.

popup_footer_note.message: Collection runs page by page in a new e-amusement tab. Data is stored only in this browser, and is reflected to iidx-rank right after collection when you are logged in.
